contract.execution: SECURITY DEFINER, fixed search_path; EXECUTE granted only to service_role
contract.actor: Actor is accepted only from service_role and must exist in the O03 public.admins role table; recorded as uploaded_by and admin_audit_log.admin_id.
contract.validationBoundary: O04 Edge authenticates the caller and validates the complete PNG bytes before Storage upload/RPC. SQL checks normalized metadata and does not decode PNG bytes.
contract.object: Path is derived as branding/<asset UUID>.png; registration requires the private branding-assets Storage row.
contract.limits: New registrations use byte, dimension, and pixel limits from the validated branding_policy and remain subject to the existing hard table constraints.
contract.idempotency: Exact immutable metadata retries return the same ID without duplicate audit rows; conflicts, revoked IDs, missing objects, invalid actors/metadata, and any effective Oorva brand/runtime/editor OFF state fail closed.
unchanged: No direct app_branding_assets privileges are granted.
Existing O03 draft, publication, rollback, snapshot, and revocation behavior is unchanged.
No feature flag is enabled; no public/native cutover or production repair is performed.

scenarios: service_role-only RPC execution and denied anon/authenticated execution
no direct service_role access to app_branding_assets
fixed private path, valid registration, actor attribution, and idempotent retry
invalid hash, configured byte/dimension/pixel ceilings, and missing Storage object
unlisted actor, conflicting retry, and revoked asset rejection
concurrent identical registration with distinct backend PIDs and one audit event

rollout.promotion: Not authorized from this lane; wait for 0102 integration or explicit release.
